excerpt: With rapid streams of letters presented to both visual hemifields, a central cue instructed participants to attend one stream and count target letters. Following the cue, alpha power ipsilateral to the cued direction increased above pre-cue baseline, with no contralateral decreases, while bilateral stimulation continued throughout each trial.
overview: This design directly addresses the idling alternative. Because visual stimulation remains present bilaterally, an alpha increase above baseline over the ignored stream is harder to explain as a passive rebound after stimulus offset. It supports active suppression of the to-be-ignored stream, while still leaving open whether the suppression acts at early sensory, later attentional, or multiple processing levels.
title: Bilateral RSVP Suppression Test
